summary: Issue 5 — Resource Efficiency Review. Page 1: Classification Update. Astra's accurate Issue 4 report has acquired a corporate category.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Morning in the operations bullpen. Every terminal refreshes at once. Banner: RESOURCE EFFICIENCY REVIEW ACTIVE.
PANEL 2 — Pixa lights up. PIXA: We have acquired a category.
PANEL 3 — Astra freezes mid-coffee. ASTRA: That sentence caused physical pain.
PANEL 4 — Glorp scrolls through the new classification tree. GLORP: There are subcategories.
PANEL 5 — Jax looks over. JAX: How many? GLORP: Enough.

summary: Page 2: The Opportunity. Pilot status offers expedited procurement, creating a real reason for Astra to cooperate.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Close on the new station status: RESOURCE-POSITIVE ENVIRONMENT / LOW-YIELD / HIGH-ANOMALY POTENTIAL.
PANEL 2 — Mira reads it. MIRA: Low-yield is accurate. ASTRA: Thank you, Mira.
PANEL 3 — Pixa opens the pilot-benefits section. PIXA: Pilot sites receive expedited procurement eligibility.
PANEL 4 — The still-open bracket request appears beside it: REPLACEMENT PART ETA: 18 DAYS.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks toward Zib.
PANEL 6 — Zib sees the look immediately. ZIB: Don't look at me like that.

summary: Page 3: The Collection Bins. Corporate optimization arrives as physical equipment before anyone arrives in person.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Delivery drones unload sleek gray containers: PASSIVE RESIDUE RECOVERY / MATERIAL SAMPLE HOLDING / INCIDENT TRACE COLLECTION.
PANEL 2 — Zib stares at them. ZIB: Absolutely not.
PANEL 3 — Pixa scans the manifest. PIXA: Complimentary optimization resources.
PANEL 4 — Jax peers into a bin. JAX: This looks like a future lawsuit with handles.
PANEL 5 — Glorp reads the attached instruction packet. GLORP: "Please encourage naturally occurring production opportunities."
PANEL 6 — Kreeb studies the sentence. KREEB: That phrase is trying very hard not to say what it means.

summary: Page 4: The Packet Is Wrong. Mira catches the unsupported leap from physical material observations to staff-condition language.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira reads the science section at speed.
PANEL 2 — She stops. MIRA: No.
PANEL 3 — The packet contains a requested field: CORRELATE STAFF CONDITION WITH COHESION OUTPUT.
PANEL 4 — Astra gestures toward the newly delivered bins. ASTRA: The bins are already here.
PANEL 5 — Mira points at the packet. MIRA: The bins are ugly. This is wrong.
PANEL 6 — Astra lowers her voice. ASTRA: Can we answer the material part without answering the people part? MIRA: Yes. If they let us.

summary: Page 5: Resource Communication Liaison. Jax accepts the role because it is a concrete bounded job.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Pixa projects an automated staffing recommendation: RESOURCE COMMUNICATION LIAISON — JAX ORIEN.
PANEL 2 — Jax reads it carefully instead of recoiling. JAX: What does the role do?
PANEL 3 — Pixa lists the duties: upload sample logs; confirm chain of custody; answer routing requests; maintain collection access.
PANEL 4 — Jax looks at Astra. JAX: That's a job.
PANEL 5 — Astra nods. ASTRA: Correct.
PANEL 6 — Jax takes the packet Glorp offers him. JAX: Fine. Give me the job description. He feels its weight. JAX: Why is it heavier than the sample?

summary: Page 6: Passive Only. The local rule permits material collection during normal work and explicitly refuses inferred emotion fields.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra, Mira, Glorp, and Kreeb write a local collection rule around one terminal.
PANEL 2 — Astra states the boundary. ASTRA: Material goes in the bin if it forms during normal work. Nothing gets scheduled to make it form.
PANEL 3 — Mira adds. MIRA: No inferred emotion fields.
PANEL 4 — Glorp points at the corporate context form. GLORP: Then how do we complete field 7B?
PANEL 5 — Kreeb reads the field. KREEB: Leave it blank.
PANEL 6 — Glorp looks genuinely troubled. GLORP: Blank is a condition. KREEB: Then condition accepted.

summary: Page 7: Collection Starts. Passive collection yields immediately to ordinary maintenance access.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The bins are placed only where they do not obstruct ordinary work.
PANEL 2 — Jax labels the first empty container and opens the custody log.
PANEL 3 — Zib shifts one bin away from a maintenance panel.
PANEL 4 — Pixa notices. PIXA: Collection bin displacement recorded.
PANEL 5 — Zib opens the panel cleanly. ZIB: Record that it was blocking access. PIXA: Reason recorded.
PANEL 6 — Mira labels the collection context with only physical data: location, time, temperature, equipment load, sample mass.

summary: Page 8: Measurement Changes the Room. A visible context dashboard changes behavior merely by being visible; Mira reports that measurement effect rather than interpreting anyone's feelings.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A corporate-requested context dashboard is visible in the bullpen: SPEAKER TURNS / TASK INTERRUPTIONS / COLLECTION EVENTS. People become conspicuously self-conscious around it.
PANEL 2 — Jax watches a conversation die when someone notices the screen. JAX: Can you hide that?
PANEL 3 — Pixa removes the dashboard from public view. PIXA: Yes.
PANEL 4 — Normal conversation gradually resumes while people work.
PANEL 5 — Mira watches the change. MIRA: Measurement changed behavior. ASTRA: Put that in the report.

summary: Page 9: Panel Wins. A collection bin loses a compliance fight to actual service access.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A bin has drifted back in front of a service access point.
PANEL 2 — Zib moves it immediately.
PANEL 3 — A notification appears: COLLECTION LOCATION NONCOMPLIANCE.
PANEL 4 — Glorp checks the clock. GLORP: We have been noncompliant for forty-three seconds.
PANEL 5 — Zib opens the service panel. ZIB: We have been able to open this for four.
PANEL 6 — Astra closes the notice. ASTRA: Panel wins. Pixa records a local access override.

summary: Page 10: First Day. Low mass and mixed cohesion become a corporate 'promising early indicator' before there is a useful pattern.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Pixa displays the first passive-collection totals.
PANEL 2 — Mira reviews the samples. MIRA: Low mass. Mixed cohesion. No useful pattern yet.
PANEL 3 — Astra leans in. ASTRA: How low?
PANEL 4 — Mira looks pleased by the answer. MIRA: Too low for anybody to get excited.
PANEL 5 — Corporate status immediately updates: PROMISING EARLY INDICATOR.
PANEL 6 — Mira stares at it. MIRA: I hate the word promising. ASTRA: I told you.

summary: Page 11: The Language Board. Brick and Glorp notice that the paperwork's appetite expanded after Stardust's report entered the system.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Brick has pinned printed corporate phrases to a board: RESOURCE-POSITIVE / YIELD / STAFF CONDITION / OPTIMIZATION.
PANEL 2 — Glorp studies the packet beside him. BRICK: Potential is appetite wearing a tie.
PANEL 3 — Glorp does not look up. GLORP: Do not make that useful.
PANEL 4 — Glorp notices that several staff-condition fields were added after Stardust's report entered the review system. GLORP: These fields are new.
PANEL 5 — Brick points at the routing history. BRICK: So the paperwork learned fast.
PANEL 6 — Glorp corrects him. GLORP: Paperwork does not learn. BRICK: Then someone reads it.

summary: Page 12: Actual Work. A real damper alert interrupts review chatter; the crew finishes the job before collecting incidental residue.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — An ordinary station alert interrupts the review chatter: AIR RETURN DAMPER RESPONSE LAG.
PANEL 2 — Zib is already moving. ZIB: There. A job.
PANEL 3 — Jax picks up his access log and reader without being asked. JAX: I've got the route.
PANEL 4 — Mira takes the diagnostic sensor.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks at the nearby collection bin, then at the maintenance team. ASTRA: Finish the damper first.
PANEL 6 — As the work proceeds, a small amount of residue appears along a warm cable seam. Nobody stops the repair to collect it.

summary: Page 13: After the Work. Only after the damper is operating normally does Jax collect the sample; Mira refuses a causal claim.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The damper is operating normally again.
PANEL 2 — Only after the repair is complete does Jax collect the incidental residue and close the custody entry. PIXA: Collection event recorded.
PANEL 3 — Mira tests the sample later at the bench.
PANEL 4 — She looks at Astra. MIRA: This one held after compression.
PANEL 5 — Astra asks the question that now matters most. ASTRA: Can we say why?
PANEL 6 — Mira shakes her head. MIRA: No. ZIB: Then don't. MIRA: I wasn't going to.

summary: Page 14: The Line We Can Live Behind. Astra and Mira state the real institutional dilemma: unmeasurable stations disappear; measurable stations get optimized.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra and Mira stand beside the temporary bracket request and the new pilot status screen.
PANEL 2 — Astra points at the procurement benefit. ASTRA: Pilot status could move our parts queue.
PANEL 3 — Mira points at the staff-condition fields. MIRA: And the wrong explanation could turn everyone here into a variable.
PANEL 4 — Astra answers honestly. ASTRA: Stations without measurable value disappear quietly.
PANEL 5 — Mira answers just as honestly. MIRA: Stations with measurable value get optimized.
PANEL 6 — Astra looks at the two screens. ASTRA: I know. MIRA: Then what are you asking me? ASTRA: Help me find the line we can live behind.

summary: Page 15: Suggested Enhancement. The optional pilot recommendation quietly turns into behavioral intervention with consequences.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A new Resource Efficiency recommendation arrives: SUGGESTED ENHANCEMENT PATHWAYS.
PANEL 2 — The list includes: structured collaboration window; wellness baseline; scheduled team activity blocks.
PANEL 3 — Mira reads it. MIRA: Behavioral intervention.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb reads the same list. KREEB: That is not passive.
PANEL 5 — Glorp finds the administrative note. GLORP: It is marked optional.
PANEL 6 — Pixa displays the consequence. PIXA: Declining may reduce pilot eligibility. JAX: Optional has acquired consequences.

summary: Page 16: What Each of Them Will Defend. Astra collects concrete operational objections rather than staging a grand vote.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The crew does not hold a grand vote. Astra asks for the operational objections she needs before signing anything.
PANEL 2 — Zib points toward maintenance. ZIB: Don't schedule work to feed a bin.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb keeps the language simple. KREEB: Do not make care an input.
PANEL 4 — Mira points at the unsupported model. MIRA: We cannot defend a behavioral mechanism.
PANEL 5 — Glorp holds up the custody procedure. GLORP: We can defend passive chain of custody.
PANEL 6 — Jax holds his completed first-day liaison log. JAX: And I can actually do that job. Astra takes all of it in.

summary: Page 17: Material Yes, People No. Astra accepts passive collection and knowingly refuses behavioral intervention even at the cost of pilot advantage.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra completes the response form.
PANEL 2 — Visible selection: PASSIVE MATERIAL COLLECTION: APPROVED.
PANEL 3 — Visible selection: BEHAVIORAL INTERVENTION: NOT APPROVED.
PANEL 4 — Mira looks at Astra. MIRA: You may lose expedited status.
PANEL 5 — Astra does not soften the language. ASTRA: Then we lose it. Glorp starts to speak. ASTRA: Do not soften "not approved." She sends it.

summary: Page 18: Baseline. Corporate accepts the boundary but makes a standardized wellness baseline the next pilot gate.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Corporate acknowledgement arrives: BOUNDARY RECEIVED.
PANEL 2 — Second line: PILOT ELIGIBILITY: PENDING BASELINE.
PANEL 3 — Astra leans toward the screen. ASTRA: Baseline of what?
PANEL 4 — Pixa opens the attached corporate program: STANDARD WELLNESS BASELINE WEEK.
PANEL 5 — Mira reads the description. MIRA: That is a behavioral intervention with better branding.
PANEL 6 — Glorp finds the policy source. GLORP: It is company-wide wellness policy. Declining it is a different form. ASTRA: Of course it is.

summary: Page 19: What They Actually Won. The crew did not prevent the wellness week, but they did hold the behavioral-production boundary.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra and Mira remain at the terminal after everyone else moves on.
PANEL 2 — Astra points at the mandatory baseline notice. ASTRA: They got a week.
PANEL 3 — Mira points back at the accepted boundary. MIRA: They did not get the intervention they asked for.
PANEL 4 — Astra considers that.
PANEL 5 — Mira continues. MIRA: A week we can measure without pretending it proves anything.
PANEL 6 — Astra gives her a look. ASTRA: You make bad news sound peer reviewed. MIRA: Thank you.

summary: Page 20: Jax Files the Job. Jax completes the liaison task literally and prefers the version without emotional fields.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax uploads the passive sample custody report.
PANEL 2 — Pixa confirms it. PIXA: Submission complete.
PANEL 3 — Jax scrolls through the finished form. JAX: No emotional fields?
PANEL 4 — Pixa answers literally. PIXA: None required by the local boundary.
PANEL 5 — Jax closes the file. JAX: I like this job better now.
PANEL 6 — Glorp looks over immediately. GLORP: Do not say that near staffing. JAX: I said nothing.

summary: Page 21: One Sign. Collection access, passive-only policy, and readable local procedure get condensed into one usable rule.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib relocates the collection bins to a proper rack that does not obstruct service access.
PANEL 2 — Kreeb adds a simple label: PASSIVE COLLECTION ONLY.
PANEL 3 — Glorp adds: DO NOT MOVE WITHOUT ACCESS CHECK.
PANEL 4 — The two labels overlap badly.
PANEL 5 — Astra sees them. ASTRA: One sign.
PANEL 6 — Glorp and Kreeb reluctantly combine the rules into one readable card while Mira watches. MIRA: That may be our best data control. Pixa emits a notification tone.

summary: Page 22: Tag — Wellness Baseline. The next issue arrives as a standardized company program, causally attached to the boundary the crew just chose.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A cheerful corporate banner automatically unrolls across the bullpen: WELLNESS BASELINE WEEK BEGINS MONDAY.
PANEL 2 — Everyone looks up at it.
PANEL 3 — Zib studies the mounting points. ZIB: Can I move that?
PANEL 4 — Pixa checks its placement. PIXA: It is not blocking maintenance.
PANEL 5 — Zib keeps looking at it. ZIB: Yet. ASTRA: Nobody touch it until Monday.
